newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish bond yields reverse earlier strength.
newsitem.headline: Swedish bond yields reverse earlier strength.

text.p: Swedish bond yields reversed the gains made early Wednesday despite stronger foreign markets.
"Profit-taking probably explains the reverse. The ten-year bond yields were down at a resistance level at 6.67 percent before they turned," one analyst said.
Six months T-bill rates rose one basis point to 4.13 percent while the ten-year bond yields were flat at 6.69 percent.
The Swedish Debt Office 7.5 billion T-bill issue at 1050 GMT was expected to be well received.
The crown was stable at 4.4700 against the mark compared to 4.4720 late on Tuesday.
Sweden's May trade balance was 11.1 billion crowns compared to 11.6 billion crowns which was expected by the market but this had no impact on the market, dealers said.
Dealers said the next market focus was the U.S. durable goods orders.
